newsitem.title: TAIWAN: FedEx says crash flight flew from Philippines.
newsitem.headline: FedEx says crash flight flew from Philippines.

text.p: Federal Express Corp said on Friday that a flight that crash-landed and burst into flames in New Jersey had originated in the Philippines and not Taiwan as some media had reported.
All five crew escaped through a cockpit window with injuries after Thursday's fiery crash at Newark International Airport.

A FedEx executive in Hong Kong told Reuters by telephone the cargo carrier was cooperating with U.S. aviation authorities investigating the accident, but still had no details about the up to 400 pounds of "routine" hazardous materials believed to be aboard.
The flight originated at Subic Bay, the Philippines, and had stopovers in Taipei and Anchorage before its failed landing at Newark, the Hong Kong FedEx executive said.

A FedEx spokesman in the United States said typical goods carried by Federal Express include computer equipment, textiles, pharmaceuticals and auto parts. "Hazardous" cargoes include aerosol cans, gases and dry ice, he said.
FedEx said the flight had about 145,000 pounds of payload.
It said the U.S. National Transportation Safety Board and state law enforcement agency were investigating the crash.
